content: Tuta nage ꞌoina Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso ꞌilatuwa balabala ꞌawawa tupwa Yudiya ꞌalona ma ꞌilolohatoto ꞌigwaeya,
“Cimi mumuga galana ꞌoidiyega wanuwabui, weyahina Yehoba nata ꞌoida ꞌihetoloina.”
Palopita Aiseya mwalohene bewa Yoniina weyahina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Tobwau ꞌaigeda tupwa balabala ꞌawawa ꞌenana madouna ꞌoinega ꞌihepwaila latuwa ma ꞌigwae, ‘Badaina ꞌina ꞌeda wahunae ma wagihedumwalu.’”

content: Ma Yoni ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo hebai kameli hunuhunuwana tuwa, ma ꞌana gadiwana kameli ꞌwapina, ma ꞌana ꞌeꞌahai bilolo ma mwagagau tuwa.
Ma Yoniina tupwa balabala ꞌawawa ꞌilolohatoto ta meYelusalema ma Yudiya ꞌana tomiyao ma weꞌaha Yolidani papalina ꞌana tomiyao mabwaiyadi siꞌautama Yoni ꞌoina,
ma ꞌidi mumuga galana sihepwailediya, ma ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌabihe babitaisowedi weꞌaha Yolidani ꞌalona.

Ma Palisiyao ma Sadusiyao baibaiwadi wete sinaoma sabi babitaiso, ta Yoni ꞌiꞌitediya ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌabo ꞌomi gide mwata! Ma wanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega nata Yehoba ꞌina gamwasowala ꞌoinega wadena, ꞌawa?
Coinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma ꞌimi nuwabui moisa waheꞌitaedi ꞌimi paihowa bwebweꞌadi ꞌoidiyega.
Ma sahena wanuwanuwa hane ꞌabehega ꞌomi Ebalahamo tubunao ma ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyegomi. Hesi geya! Ma waꞌita Yehoba sawasawahina ma dimwa bewa ꞌoidiyega Ebalahamo tubunao ꞌipaihowadi.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌimi mumuga geya bwebweꞌadi nata Yehoba ꞌiheyatalaegomi, gide ꞌaiwe ꞌeguma geya huwaina bwebweꞌana, tomota sigoha yahuledi ma ꞌaiwe ꞌalaꞌalata ꞌoina siuledi ma sigabudi.

“Ceguma wanuwabui, taugu weꞌahega yaꞌabihe babitaisowegomi, ma hesi ꞌabwa ꞌaigeda loheya muliguwega ꞌinaonaoma, tauna ꞌimadou sinegauwa, ta geya ꞌilobwainegau ma weyahina ꞌana butu yalihasi. Ma loheyaina ꞌitauyama, ma Yaluyaluwa Tabuna, gide ꞌaiwe ninima, ꞌoinega nata ꞌiꞌabihe babitaiso.
Ma wete ꞌina goliyega witi ꞌisapidi ma huwaidi sigubala ma muliyetega huwaina ꞌausaladi ꞌihedodo ꞌina hada ꞌeꞌahai, ma mohomohowedi ꞌigabudi ꞌaiwe ninima hatayaina ꞌoina.”
Tuta nage ꞌoina Yesu tupwa Galili ꞌiꞌebesineya ma ꞌinaowa Yolidani, Yoni ꞌoina, sabi babitaiso.
Coinega Yoni nuwanuwana Yesu baꞌidana sihesaꞌugelasa, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Cilobwaineya ma ꞌowa ꞌuꞌabihe babitaisogau, ma togidega ꞌunaoma ma ꞌabehega taugu yaꞌabihe babitaisogo?”
Ma Yesu Yoni ꞌina gwae ꞌihemaiseya, ꞌigwae, “Geya. Hesi bewa gide ꞌowa ꞌuꞌabihe babitaisogau. Weyahina bewa ꞌoinega loina mabwaiyadi ꞌausaladi tamuliyedi.”
Coinega Yoni ꞌitagwala ma Yesu ꞌiꞌabihe babitaisoya. Ma ꞌoinega Yesu weꞌahega ꞌigayohanema, ma galewa ꞌiꞌesoꞌeya ma Yesu Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ꞌiꞌiteya ꞌana ꞌita gide gabubu ꞌisuluma ma ꞌoina ꞌitowa.
Ma hesi ꞌaigeda ꞌenana galewega ꞌigwaema ꞌigwae, “Beno natugu moisa. Tauna weyahina yayaliyaya madouna.”
